advancements.phantomism.discovery.root.d: Discover the phantoms of your world
screen.phantomism.staff.title: Manage Phantoms
screen.phantomism.staff.select_target: Right-click the target you want the Phantom to attack
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.follow: Follow you and roam nearby when you stop. Keeps the assigned activity.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.stay: Hold the current position instead of following you. Still responds to danger.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.guard: Follow and protect you, intercepting nearby hostile mobs.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.wander: Patrol the configured area around Home, defend it from nearby monsters, then return after combat. Without Home, roam locally. Keeps the assigned activity.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.attack_t: Select this, then right-click an enemy in sight up to 32 blocks away. Left-click to cancel selection.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.recall: Teleport your selected loaded phantoms near you and switch them to Follow Me. Does not return them Home.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.clear_ta: Stop attacking the current target and briefly suppress retaliation. Keeps movement and activity orders.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.guard_po: Select this, then right-click a solid block. Patrol that location, intercept nearby threats, and return after combat.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.set_home: Select this, then sneak-right-click a bed to assign Home. Sets a reference for wandering and activities without moving your phantoms.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.return_h: Fly to safe air near the assigned Home in this dimension, then stay there. Pauses the activity during travel without erasing it. Requires a Home.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.activity: Stop Harvest, Hunt, or Collect without changing movement. Any carried items are kept.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.harvest: Clear nearby short grass while keeping the movement order. Respects mob griefing and block protection; leaves crops and flowers alone.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.hunt: Automatically hunt nearby hostile mobs, not players, pets, or passive animals. Direct attack orders take priority.
screen.phantomism.staff.tooltip.collect: Pick up nearby accessible dropped items and deliver them when you are close. Carries one stack at a time; keeps it if your inventory is full.
screen.phantomism.staff.select_home: Shift-right-click a bed to set Home; left-click to cancel
screen.phantomism.staff.select_guard: Right-click a solid block to guard it; left-click to cancel
message.phantomism.staff.invalid_positio: No safe guard position above that block
config.phantomism.phantom.tooltip: Home patrol size and automatic protection of same-owner companions.
config.phantomism.phantom.homeRadius.too: Horizontal distance in blocks from the assigned bed. Default: 200; allowed: 4-1000. Patrols and activities only use loaded chunks; existing saved values are kept.
config.phantomism.phantom.familyDefenseR: Nearby adults defend hurt same-owner pets from attackers within their awareness range. Does not take control from riders, replace active targets, or retaliate against owner/family hits or environmental damage. Default: 32; allowed: 4-64.
config.phantomism.blackPhantom.tooltip: Black Phantom stats and species settings. Default values preserve normal balance.
config.phantomism.blackPhantom.stats.too: Applies to adults, babies, wild and tamed phantoms. Existing loaded phantoms update within one second. Increasing maximum health does not heal existing pets. Ability bonuses are separate.
config.phantomism.blackPhantom.stats.max: Health points: 2 = 1 heart. Allowed: 1-1024. Raising the limit does not heal existing pets; lowering it clamps their current health.
config.phantomism.blackPhantom.stats.att: Base melee damage: 2 = 1 heart. Allowed: 0-2048. Ability bonuses stack separately; projectile and area damage stay unchanged.
config.phantomism.blackPhantom.stats.arm: Armor points used by Minecraft's damage reduction formula. 2 = 1 armor icon. Allowed: 0-30.
Reduces armor penetration from powerful hits. A vanilla diamond armor piece provides 2. Allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.blackPhantom.stats.mov: Base movement attribute; ability bonuses are added separately. Default: 0.25; allowed: 0.01-2.
config.phantomism.blackPhantom.stats.fly: Scales autonomous flight and mounted horizontal movement, not vertical aiming controls. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Extreme speeds can make navigation less reliable.
config.phantomism.blackPhantom.stats.fol: Nearby-entity sensing and autonomous combat range in blocks, separate from Home patrol size. Default: 32; allowed: 4-128. High values increase server work.

config.phantomism.blackPhantom.diveFlyin: Extra diving bite damage against flying enemies. Stacks with other applicable bonuses. Default: 2; allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.blackPhantom.divePhant: Additional dive damage against hostile vanilla Phantoms, never companion phantoms. Default: 4; allowed: 0-20.

config.phantomism.waterPhantom.stats.fly: Scales normal flight and Water Drive swimming, including mounted horizontal movement. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Very high values can make navigation less reliable.
config.phantomism.waterPhantom.stats.fol: Nearby-entity sensing and autonomous combat range in blocks, separate from Home patrol size. Default: 32; allowed: 4-128. High values increase server work.
config.phantomism.stormPhantom.tooltip: Storm Phantom stats. Rain and thunderstorms add temporary movement and awareness bonuses; stored natural lightning powers her abilities.
config.phantomism.stormPhantom.stats.too: Applies to adults, babies, wild and tamed phantoms. Existing loaded phantoms update within one second. Increasing maximum health does not heal existing pets. Weather and charge bonuses are separate.
config.phantomism.stormPhantom.stats.max: Health points: 2 = 1 heart. Default: 38; allowed: 1-1024. Raising the limit does not heal existing pets; lowering it clamps their current health.
config.phantomism.stormPhantom.stats.att: Base melee damage: 2 = 1 heart. Default: 4; allowed: 0-2048. Lightning Jolt and Thunderstorm damage are balanced separately.
config.phantomism.stormPhantom.stats.arm: Armor points used by Minecraft's damage reduction formula. Default: 3; allowed: 0-30. 2 points = 1 armor icon.
Reduces armor penetration from powerful hits. Default: 0; allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.stormPhantom.stats.kno: 0 = no resistance; 1 = full resistance. Default: 0.15; allowed: 0-1.
config.phantomism.stormPhantom.stats.mov: Base movement attribute. Default: 0.25; allowed: 0.01-2. Exposed rain adds 15 percent; thunderstorms add 30 percent.
config.phantomism.stormPhantom.stats.fly: Scales autonomous and mounted horizontal flight. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Weather bonuses are added separately; vertical aiming controls remain shared.
config.phantomism.stormPhantom.stats.fol: Base awareness in blocks. Default: 32; allowed: 4-128. Eye of the Storm adds 8 blocks in exposed rain and 16 during thunderstorms. Home patrol radius is separate.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.sand_p: Discover a Sand Phantom surveying the desert dunes.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.tooltip: Patient desert ambusher. Immune to cactus damage, with modest heat resilience and faster low flight over desert sand. Not immune to lava.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.stats.tool: Applies to adults, babies, wild and tamed phantoms. Existing loaded phantoms update within one second. Raising maximum health does not heal pets. Desert and diving bonuses are separate.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.stats.maxH: Health points: 2 = 1 heart. Default: 36; allowed: 1-1024. Raising the limit does not heal existing pets; lowering it clamps their current health.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.stats.atta: Base melee damage before armor. Default: 4; allowed: 0-2048. Sand Dive adds 5 damage to a prepared diving bite; Sand Bolt and Sandstorm are balanced separately.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.stats.armo: Armor points used by Minecraft's damage reduction formula. Default: 3; allowed: 0-30. 2 points = 1 armor icon.
Reduces armor penetration from powerful hits. Default: 0; allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.stats.knoc: 0 = no resistance; 1 = full resistance. Default: 0.15; allowed: 0-1.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.stats.move: Base movement attribute. Default: 0.25; allowed: 0.01-2. Flying near desert sand adds 15 percent without stacking repeatedly.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.stats.flyi: Scales autonomous and mounted horizontal flight. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Low desert flight adds 15 percent. Mounted vertical controls remain unchanged.
config.phantomism.sandPhantom.stats.foll: Brain sensing and pursuit range in blocks. Default: 32; allowed: 4-128. Guard's Sand Awareness watches threats within 24 blocks of the owner. Home patrol radius is separate.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.gold_p: Discover a rare Gold Phantom exploring the badlands or stony peaks.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.tooltip: Tactical treasure hunter with visible cave hints, blinding Gold Dust, Gold Rush, Golden Shield and a finishing Gold Eye. Gold Eye rewards at most 3 nuggets per owner per minute, only on its own hostile killing blow.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.stats.tool: Applies to wild and tamed adults and babies. Loaded phantoms update within one second. Raising maximum health does not heal pets. Ability bonuses are separate.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.stats.maxH: Health points: 2 = 1 heart. Default: 36; allowed: 1-1024. Raising the limit does not heal pets; lowering it clamps their health.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.stats.atta: Base melee damage before armor. Default: 4; allowed: 0-2048. Gold Rush adds 5 damage to a prepared dive. Gold Dust and Gold Eye damage are balanced separately.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.stats.armo: Armor points used by Minecraft's damage reduction formula. Default: 5; allowed: 0-30.
Reduces armor penetration from powerful hits. Default: 0; allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.stats.knoc: 0 = no resistance; 1 = full resistance. Default: 0.15; allowed: 0-1. Golden Shield adds a temporary 0.7 bonus.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.stats.move: Base movement attribute. Default: 0.25; allowed: 0.01-2. Gold Rush uses the shared fast diving combat movement.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.stats.flyi: Scales autonomous and mounted horizontal flight. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Mounted vertical aiming controls remain shared.
config.phantomism.goldPhantom.stats.foll: Brain sensing and pursuit range in blocks. Default: 32; allowed: 4-128. Cave hints scan visible loaded openings within 25 blocks every five seconds, without moving toward them or revealing hidden ores.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.cherry: Discover a graceful Cherry Phantom among the blossoms of a Cherry Grove.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.tooltip: Gentle blossom guardian. She prioritizes healing and ranged support, with a delicate blossom crown, petal-patterned wings and protective sanctuary.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.stats.to: Applies to wild and tamed adults and babies. Loaded phantoms update within one second. Raising maximum health does not heal pets. Support heals only her owner and same-owner companions; babies cannot cast combat abilities.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.stats.ma: Health points: 2 = 1 heart. Default: 34; allowed: 1-1024. Raising the limit does not heal pets; lowering it clamps their health.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.stats.at: Base close-range defensive bite damage. Default: 3; allowed: 0-2048. Petal Barrage and sanctuary pulses are balanced separately.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.stats.ar: Armor points used by Minecraft's damage reduction formula. Default: 3; allowed: 0-30.
Reduces armor penetration from powerful hits. Default: 0; allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.stats.kn: 0 = no resistance; 1 = full resistance. Default: 0.1; allowed: 0-1. Sakura Veil grants temporary Resistance rather than changing this attribute.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.stats.mo: Base movement attribute. Default: 0.25; allowed: 0.01-2. Cherry prefers a supportive ranged orbit to repeated dives.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.stats.fl: Scales autonomous and mounted horizontal flight. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Her slower graceful wingbeats are cosmetic; mounted controls remain shared.
config.phantomism.cherryPhantom.stats.fo: Brain sensing and pursuit range in blocks. Default: 32; allowed: 4-128. Family support and Eternal Blossom are separately limited to 12 blocks and loaded, visible recipients.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.phanto: Discover a proud aerial guardian among the mountain peaks.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.tooltip: Durable aerial assault companion. Demon Horns, draconic dives, sustained breath and violet fireballs; 1.25x shared-model size, not a transformation.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.stats.to: Loaded phantoms update within one second. Raising maximum health does not heal pets. Dragon Wings and Fury add temporary bonuses separately; babies cannot use combat abilities.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.stats.ma: Health points: 2 = 1 heart. Default: 46; allowed: 1-1024. Raising the limit does not heal pets; lowering it clamps their health.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.stats.at: Base melee damage. Default: 6; allowed: 0-2048. Draconic Dive adds 6; Strength and armor apply normally. Breath and fireball damage are balanced separately.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.stats.ar: Armor points used by Minecraft's damage reduction formula. Default: 5; allowed: 0-30.
Reduces armor penetration from powerful hits. Default: 0; allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.stats.kn: 0 = no resistance; 1 = full resistance. Default: 0.2; allowed: 0-1. Dragon Wings adds 0.35 while adults are airborne, not swimming.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.stats.mo: Base movement attribute. Default: 0.25; allowed: 0.01-2. Dragon's Fury temporarily increases it by 20%.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.stats.fl: Autonomous and mounted horizontal flight speed. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Fury adds 20%; vertical controls remain shared.
config.phantomism.phantomDragon.stats.fo: Brain sensing and pursuit range in blocks. Default: 32; allowed: 4-128. Breath, shockwaves and fireballs keep their own bounded ranges.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.violet: Discover an elegant violet duelist in a meadow or flower forest.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.tooltip: Precision aerial duelist. Successful Lance, Dive and Crosscut hits build distinct-move Momentum; Rupture spends it. Mounted G retains the shared 0.4-second cooldown.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.stats.to: Adjust Violet's base attributes. Momentum, fixed projectile damage and ability cooldowns are separate. Defaults preserve the proposed 56 HP, 8 attack, 6 armor and 2 toughness baseline.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.stats.ma: Maximum health points. Default: 56 (28 hearts); allowed: 1-1024. Raising this does not heal existing companions.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.stats.at: Base melee damage before armor. Default: 8; allowed: 0-2048. Violet Dive adds 4 and Momentum adds up to 2.25 damage; Lance, Crosscut and Rupture use separate values.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.stats.ar: Armor points used by normal Minecraft damage reduction. Default: 6; allowed: 0-30.
Protection against large hits penetrating armor. Default: 2; allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.stats.kn: 0 = no resistance; 1 = complete resistance. Default: 0.2; allowed: 0-1.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.stats.mo: Base movement attribute. Default: 0.25; allowed: 0.01-2. Violet Overdrive temporarily adds 15%.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.stats.fl: Autonomous and mounted horizontal flight speed. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Overdrive temporarily adds 15%; vertical controls remain shared.
config.phantomism.violetPhantom.stats.fo: Brain sensing and pursuit range in blocks. Default: 32; allowed: 4-128. Abilities keep their own bounded ranges; larger sensing distances increase server work.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.toxic_: Discover a corrosive companion in a swamp or mangrove swamp.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.tooltip: Corrosion and area-denial companion. Acid applies temporary Armor Fracture and poison; she resists both. Shield reflection cannot chain recursively. Mounted G uses the shared 0.4-second cooldown.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.stats.too: Adjust Toxic's base attributes. Defaults: 64 HP, 6 attack, 8 armor, 2 toughness, 35% knockback resistance and 48-block awareness. Ability values and ranges are separate.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.stats.max: Maximum health points. Default: 64 (32 hearts); allowed: 1-1024. Raising this does not heal existing companions.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.stats.att: Base melee damage before armor. Default: 6; allowed: 0-2048. Acid Dive adds 3; projectile, pulse and periodic area damage use separate values.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.stats.arm: Armor points used by normal Minecraft damage reduction. Default: 8; allowed: 0-30.
Protection against large hits penetrating armor. Default: 2; allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.stats.kno: 0 = no resistance; 1 = full resistance. Default: 0.35; allowed: 0-1.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.stats.mov: Base movement attribute. Default: 0.25; allowed: 0.01-2. Shared navigation remains unchanged.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.stats.fly: Autonomous and mounted horizontal flight speed. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Vertical controls remain shared; this is not the legacy cruise-speed scale.
config.phantomism.toxicPhantom.stats.fol: Brain sensing and pursuit range in blocks. Default: 48; allowed: 4-128. Projectiles remain limited to 32 blocks; the toxic zone has a 10-block radius.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.sculk_: Discover a Sculk Phantom among the Ancient City ruins.
config.phantomism.sculkPhantom.tooltip: Corrosion and area-denial companion. Acid applies temporary Armor Fracture and poison; she resists both. Shield reflection cannot chain recursively. Mounted G uses the shared 0.4-second cooldown.
config.phantomism.sculkPhantom.stats.too: Adjust Sculk's base attributes. Defaults: 64 HP, 6 attack, 8 armor, 2 toughness, 35% knockback resistance and 48-block awareness. Ability values and ranges are separate.
config.phantomism.sculkPhantom.stats.max: Maximum health points. Default: 64 (32 hearts); allowed: 1-1024. Raising this does not heal existing companions.
config.phantomism.sculkPhantom.stats.att: Base melee damage before armor. Default: 6; allowed: 0-2048. Acid Dive adds 3; projectile, pulse and periodic area damage use separate values.
config.phantomism.sculkPhantom.stats.arm: Armor points used by normal Minecraft damage reduction. Default: 8; allowed: 0-30.
Protection against large hits penetrating armor. Default: 2; allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.sculkPhantom.stats.kno: 0 = no resistance; 1 = full resistance. Default: 0.35; allowed: 0-1.
config.phantomism.sculkPhantom.stats.mov: Base movement attribute. Default: 0.25; allowed: 0.01-2. Shared navigation remains unchanged.
config.phantomism.sculkPhantom.stats.fly: Autonomous and mounted horizontal flight speed. Default: 0.4; allowed: 0.01-2. Vertical controls remain shared; this is not the legacy cruise-speed scale.
config.phantomism.sculkPhantom.stats.fol: Brain sensing and pursuit range in blocks. Default: 48; allowed: 4-128. Projectiles remain limited to 32 blocks; the sculk zone has a 10-block radius.
advancements.phantomism.discovery.ravage: Discover a Ravager Phantom near a Pillager Outpost or an active raid. He is not a raid member.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.tooltip: Heavy bruiser and siege mount. Nine core abilities; owner-mounted Ctrl starts Siege Charge, and G performs a close Ram/Bite.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.bulldoz: Allow charge-only clearing of tagged natural foliage. Persistent player leaves, containers, unbreakable and protected blocks stay safe. Requires mobGriefing and owner permission.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.siegeBr: Enable owner-mounted breaching of tagged blocks with sufficient momentum and a suitable held tool. Maximum forward profile: 3 x 3. Turning this off does not disable combat.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.stats.t: Base stats apply to loaded Ravager Phantoms within one second. Ability damage and temporary Fury bonuses are separate.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.stats.m: Health points; 2 = 1 heart. Default: 76; allowed: 1-1024. Increasing this does not heal existing companions.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.stats.a: Base physical Bite damage. Default: 9; allowed: 0-2048. Dive adds 5. Ram and Slam use separate fixed initial balance values.
Reduces armor penetration from heavy hits. Default: 3; allowed: 0-20.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.stats.k: 0 = no resistance; 1 = full resistance. Default: 0.45; allowed: 0-1.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.stats.m: Base movement speed. Default: 0.22; allowed: 0.01-2. Fury adds a temporary 15% bonus.
config.phantomism.ravagerPhantom.stats.f: Base autonomous and mounted horizontal flight speed. Default: 0.32; allowed: 0.01-2. Charge accelerates separately with capped momentum.
Brain sensing and pursuit range in blocks. Default: 32; allowed: 4-128. Presence radius is 8; Roar radius is 12.
